answer_1.quote: we design a set of experiments with a sequence of interactions between a user and a simulated AI question-answering (QA) system.

answer_4.quote: We recruit participants who are told that they will evaluate a QA system's performance on a sequence of question-answer pairs.
answer_4.guideline: Participants decide if the system is correct and place a monetary bet on their decision; correctness is revealed afterward.
